responsibility: Centralizes Apple target construction by mapping Apple OS, architecture, and ABI variants to shared TargetOptions, canonical LLVM triple fragments, CPU baselines, linker environment cleanup, and common Darwin platform defaults.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the broader `spec/mod.rs` and the indexing-only `spec/base/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is narrowly the shared Apple base-target builder, turning Apple OS/arch/ABI combinations into common Darwin options, deployment-target-aware LLVM triples, CPUs, and link-environment cleanup.
